question: 排除分支 IEMJHuQgCPDHCwwJkgQQeaqGvzMcVD 后，2013 年总成交量是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(ft.Quantity) AS total_trade_quantity FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2013 AND db.Branch != 'IEMJHuQgCPDHCwwJkgQQeaqGvzMcVD' LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 成交量 = 成交证券数量合计（SUM(Quantity)）
排除过滤载体：分支名取 TPC-DI 变造实测值
